summaries.n-gta6-launch-coins: Coins named for Grand Theft Auto VI, which Rockstar Games released on 2026-11-19 (it posted on 2025-11-06 that the game would release on Thursday, November 19, 2026, and on 2026-11-12 that it was one week away).
